entities.summary: Gurgen Ashotovich Askaryan was a prominent Soviet-Armenian physicist, known for his discovery of the self-focusing of light, pioneering studies of light–matter interactions, and the discovery and investigation of the interaction of high-energy particles with condensed matter.
